verdict: Gorgias: Choose Gorgias when ecommerce order context, Shopify depth, and ticket-based pricing match your DTC support model — not for generic B2B helpdesk or ITSM. Scores use the customer-service editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Order context, refunds, and macros in agent workspace
AI automation bundled into ticket tiers
Clear Starter $40 entry for small stores
weaknesses: Ticket volume caps and overage risk
Not per-agent — math differs from Freshdesk/Zendesk
Self-service/KB depth below dedicated docs platforms
bestFor: Shopify and DTC brands needing order-aware support in one inbox
Ecommerce teams where ticket+AI pricing beats per-agent seat math
Support leaders who want refund/edit-order workflows native to storefronts
notIdealFor: Teams wanting simple per-agent SMB pricing (Help Scout, Zoho Desk)
tradeoffs: Per-agent seats vs ticket/conversation caps and AI outcome pricing
Omnichannel breadth vs SMB simplicity in shared inbox tools
Suite upsell complexity vs transparent published plan floors
ITSM depth vs lightweight live-chat or ecommerce helpdesk fit
recommendation: Choose Gorgias when ecommerce order context, Shopify depth, and ticket-based pricing match your DTC support model — not for generic B2B helpdesk or ITSM. Compare Freshdesk or Zendesk Suite for non-ecommerce omnichannel helpdesk. Do not force-rank against live-chat or ITSM peers.
